entries.t: [ASAP] 铁稳定化多硫化物赋能的无负极固态锂硫电池
entries.a: ACS Energy Letters: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能量存储/电化学储能/二次电池/其它电池体系
entries.as: 无负极全固态锂硫电池以硫化锂（Li2S）为正极，理论能量密度极高但面临多硫化物穿梭与界面阻抗等瓶颈。本研究提出铁稳定化多硫化物策略，利用Fe元素稳定中间产物并抑制穿梭效应，使无负极构型的固态Li-S电池实现稳定循环。该方案兼具高能量密度与简化制造工艺，为下一代高比能储能器件的工程化提供了可行路径。
kp: [电池体系]: 无负极固态Li-S电池
[活化机制]: FeCl₃生成固态多硫化物中间体
entries.b: Anode-less solid-state lithium–sulfur batteries (SSLSBs) with lithium sulfide (Li2S) as the cathode promise a high energy density and ease of manufacturing. However, Li2S is plagued by poor conductivity, sluggish activation kinetics, and a poor cycle life. Here, we report an FeCl3-activated Li2S (FLS) cathode with solid-state polysulfide intermediates generated through a redox reaction between FeCl3 and Li2S. This strategy is shown to boost the electrical conductivity of Li2S by 7 orders of magnitude and lower the activation barrier. During cycling, Fe plays a significant role in stabilizing the highly active polysulfide species, contributing to the exceptional electrochemical performance. The FLS cathode achieves 80% capacity retention over 500 cycles with >99% Li2S utilization. Furthermore, a Li-metal-free (anode-less) full cell retained over 80% of its initial capacity after 240 cycles. This work underscores the promise of leveraging Fe-stabilized polysulfides in enabling high-energy, long-lasting, solid-state Li–S batteries.

entries.t: 通过液滴下落从盐湖水中自发提取铀
entries.c: 零碳产业/物质循环/无机物/有色金属/其它有色金属产业
entries.as: 核能低碳转型背景下，铀资源的高效提取至关重要。本研究提出一种基于液滴下落运动的盐湖水自发提铀新方法，利用液滴动力学与界面化学效应实现铀酰离子的选择性捕获，无需外加能量即可从低浓度盐湖卤水中富集铀。该策略兼具低成本与环境友好特性，为非常规铀资源的规模化开发提供了创新路径。
kp: [提取方法]: 液滴下落自发提铀
entries.b: Uranium (U) is essential for the nuclear power industry and plays an important role in decarbonizing the energy supply. However, concern regarding the sustainability of U supply is growing, as conventional U ore reserves are scarce and common mining practices have a notable environmental footprint. Exploring alternative U sources and developing sustainable extraction methods are therefore desired. Here we show a spontaneous U extraction strategy based on droplet falling. Specifically, naturally falling salt-lake water droplets interact with a film of aluminium–fluorinated ethylene propylene–chitosan coated on carbon felt, converting mechanical energy into electricity and driving an in situ electrochemical process for spontaneous U extraction. Electrons released at the solid–liquid interface on a superhydrophobic fluorinated ethylene propylene surface reduce U(VI) adsorbed by chitosan to U(IV), ultimately forming U(VI) precipitates. Field experiments conducted in real salt-lake environments with high salinity confirm the scalability and robustness of droplet U extraction, yielding magnesium uranate (MgU2O7) and sodium polyuranate (Na2U7O22) as the main products. A multistep device reduces the U concentration of salt-lake water from 173 μg l−1 to 34 μg l−1 (extraction efficiency of 80.3%) with minimal extraction of co-existing ions. Overall, this work offers a viable pathway to sustainable U resource extraction.

entries.t: [ASAP] 中间体时空匹配调控电化学C–N偶联选择性
entries.a: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
entries.c: 零碳产业/物质循环/有机物（碳循环）/有机工业/电化学过程/有机电合成
entries.as: 研究电化学C-N偶联反应中中间体的时空匹配机制对选择性产物的决定性作用。电化学C-N偶联作为传统热化学路径的可持续替代方案，可用于合成含氮有机物（如胺类），但选择性控制是核心挑战。该工作阐明了碳中间体与氮中间体在电极表面的生成速率、吸附位置与反应时序的协同匹配关系，为实现高效、高选择性电化学合成含氮化学品提供了理论指导和优化方向。
kp: [电化学C-N偶联]: 时空匹配中间体调控选择性
[核心机制]: 碳源/氮源中间体同步性
entries.b: Developing electrochemical C-N coupling as a sustainable alternative to conventional thermochemical routes offers a promising pathway for converting environmentally relevant small molecules into nitrogen-containing, high-value chemicals. However, the efficiency of C-N bond formation is often limited by the lack of synchronization between carbon- and nitrogen-derived intermediates. Here, we introduce and validate spatiotemporal intermediate matching as a catalytic concept governing efficient C-N coupling. Guided by this concept, we design a functionally complementary, molecularly defined Co-Zn dual-site catalyst, featuring a subnanometer (∼1.1 nm) intersite distance to facilitate intermediate encounters and tailorable site ratios to balance their generation kinetics. In the CO2/NO3- coreduction system, the catalyst achieves near-theoretical stoichiometric coupling, leading to a 5-fold enhancement in the Faradaic efficiency for methylamine. Importantly, this concept can be extended to other C-N coupling systems, opening sustainable electrochemical routes toward higher-value amines such as dimethylamine and N-methylaniline. Our findings establish spatiotemporal intermediate matching as a guiding principle for C-N bond formation and offer a generalizable strategy for rational catalyst design toward sustainable chemical production.

entries.t: [ASAP] 基于萘二酰亚胺手性共价有机框架推进室温自旋量子比特
entries.a: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
entries.c: AI与智能科技/其它智能科技/量子信息
entries.as: 该研究以萘二酰亚胺（NDI）为核构建有机自由基 spin qubit 体系，通过分子工程优化自旋-轨道耦合与超精细相互作用，成功在室温条件下实现自旋相干性的显著延长。这一突破打破了传统 spin qubit 依赖极低温环境的限制，为低成本、可扩展的量子信息处理平台开辟新路径，推动量子计算从实验室专用设备向通用化、可民主化部署方向迈进。
kp: 材料体系[室温量子比特]: 萘二酰亚胺基手性COF
特性[室温量子比特]: 室温超长弛豫时间
entries.b: Advancing the development of qubits with room-temperature coherence is crucial for realizing and democratizing quantum computing technologies. Here, we reveal for the first time that chiral covalent organic frameworks (CCOFs) serve as ideal hosts for electron spin qubits, exhibiting exceptionally long relaxation times at room temperature. The CCOF qubits (CCOF-Qs) were readily prepared via the condensation of enantiomeric naphthalene diimide (NDI) units bearing sp3-carbon chiral centers with triformylphloroglucinol, followed by cobaltocene reduction. At room temperature, CCOF-Q exhibits a spin relaxation time (T1) of 160.5 μs, exceeding most molecular qubit frameworks (MQFs) and other classes of molecular qubits. More importantly, the phase memory time (Tm) of CCOF-Q reaches 1.7 μs, surpassing the record for MQFs. This superior spin qubit performance arises from suppressed spin-spin coupling due to staggered stacking with large interlayer distances within the chiral frameworks, and suppressed spin-phonon coupling owing to the inherent structural rigidity of CCOFs and the delocalized spins on the NDI units. Spin dynamic analysis reveals similar qubit behaviors in the two enantiomeric CCOFs, which are superior to their racemic counterpart. Together, this work demonstrates that the strategic incorporation of homochiral motifs into COF structures significantly enhances spin qubit performance, opening new avenues for quantum information science.

entries.t: [ASAP] 氧钒卟啉三聚体中的光激活量子比特耦合
entries.a: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
entries.c: AI与智能科技/其它智能科技/量子信息
entries.as: 分子自旋体系因其化学可调性与模块化结构，在量子信息科学中展现出独特优势。本研究以钒卟啉三聚体为模型，利用光激发手段实现了多个钒酰自旋中心之间的可控量子比特耦合。通过光开关机制调控自旋-自旋相互作用强度，为构建可寻址、可编程的分子量子门器件提供了新思路。该成果验证了光控分子量子比特耦合的可行性，推动了分子基量子硬件从静态研究向主动调控方向迈出关键一步，对未来量子计算架构具有潜在意义。
kp: 材料体系[分子量子比特]: 钒氧基卟啉三聚体
特性[量子比特]: 光激活超快量子比特耦合
entries.b: Molecules provide a modular and chemically tunable platform for quantum information science. In recent years, significant advances have been made in enabling optical spin initialization, coherent control, and both optical and electrical readout of molecular qubits. Yet, a central challenge remains: realizing scalable architectures through the controlled and ultrafast activation of interqubit interactions. Here, we present a molecular system composed of two vanadyl porphyrin qubits bridged by a free-base porphyrin chromophore, where the qubits are magnetically independent in the ground state but become coupled upon photoexcitation. Femtosecond transient absorption and time-resolved electron paramagnetic resonance experiments, supported by DFT calculations and spectral simulations, reveal that photoexcitation induces the formation of a spin-quintet state within subpicosecond time scales. Notably, long-lived spin polarization persists up to room temperature. Theoretical modeling offers design principles for harnessing this mechanism in future applications. These results provide a proof of concept for optically controlled spin interactions in molecules, paving the way for light-activated molecular quantum gates.

entries.t: 直接检测小行星的日心偏转：DART 后的 Didymos 系统
entries.a: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
entries.c: 通用技术/通信和运输/航天
entries.as: 2022年9月NASA的DART航天器撞击小行星Dimorphos，首次展示动能撞击防御技术。研究通过恒星掩星和雷达测量，首次直接探测到人类活动导致的天体日心轨道偏转。撞击不仅改变了Dimorphos轨道，还将动量传递至Didymos系统质心，改变其绕日公转轨道，是人类改变天体运行的首次实测。
entries.b: In September 2022, NASA's Double Asteroid Redirection Test (DART) spacecraft crashed into Dimorphos and demonstrated the kinetic impact method of protecting Earth from asteroids. A fraction of the impulse delivered to Dimorphos was also imparted onto the Didymos system's barycenter, changing its heliocentric orbit. Here, we present the first-ever measurement of human-caused change in the heliocentric orbit of a celestial body. Thanks to stellar occultation and radar measurements, we estimate that the Didymos system experienced an along-track velocity change of -11.7 ± 1.3 micrometers per second. We constrain the heliocentric momentum enhancement factor for DART at 2.0 ± 0.3 and the bulk densities of Didymos and Dimorphos at 2600 ± 140 and 1540 ± 220 kilograms per cubic meter, respectively. Our results demonstrate that targeting the secondary asteroid in binary systems constitutes a possible strategy for kinetic impact deflection, adding to humanity's planetary defense capabilities.

entries.t: [ASAP] 高熵氧化物载氧体的双杠杆设计规则：最小化自旋极化，最大化Fe-O-Ni共价性
entries.a: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
entries.as: 提出了高熵氧化物(HEO)载氧体设计的双杠杆规则：最小化自旋极化、最大化Fe-O-Ni共价性。高熵氧化物作为化学链过程的载氧体材料，长期缺乏将组分与氧化还原性能直接关联的可操作设计准则。该研究通过实验与理论计算结合，建立了自旋极化与共价键合对载氧体性能的调控规律，为高熵氧化物的理性设计提供了明确指导。
kp: CO时空收率[HEO载氧体]: 提升4.7倍
[设计规则]: 降自旋极化+增Fe-O-Ni共价性降低氧空位形成能
[高熵氧化物]: 两杠杆原理指导载氧体组分设计
entries.b: What is missing in high-entropy oxide (HEO) oxygen carrier design is an actionable rule that links composition to redox performance. We advance a two-lever principle─decrease spin polarization and increase Fe-O-Ni covalency─that lowers the oxygen-vacancy formation energy at the targeted Fe-O-Ni-linked sites and improves CO space-time yield (STY) by 4.7 times. Guided by this rule, we prepare compositionally diverse HEOs and benchmark them in chemical looping reverse water-gas shift (CL-RWGS). Spectroscopy and temperature-programmed reduction indicate that strengthening the Fe-O-Ni covalency increases the fraction of labile lattice oxygen, while electronic-structure calculations connect suppressed spin polarization to lower oxygen vacancy formation energy across representative local environments. A FeMgAlNiZn HEO following the rule achieves a STY of 8.6 mmolCO·kgcat-1·s-1 under CL-RWGS at 650 °C, substantially outperforming FeMgCoZnMn HEO that violates the rule, and maintains performance over extended cycling. The combined experimental-computational evidence establishes a mechanism-anchored, composition-level guideline for HEO oxygen carriers: avoid cations with a high spin state shift to maintain phase stability, promote Fe-O-Ni linkages to enhance covalency, and tune the electronic structure to minimize spin polarization. This design framework enables rapid, rational navigation of the vast HEO space for carbon-efficient CO2 to CO conversion.

entries.t: 具有超大斯托克斯位移的二维 NIR-II AIE 纳米治疗探针，用于手术导航和消融
entries.a: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
entries.c: 通用技术/材料工程/其它先进材料
entries.as: 研究通过一步点击反应合成了四氰基醌二甲烷衍生物NIR探针TNQ2，克服了长期存在的非荧光限制，实现了445纳米的超大斯托克斯位移。TNQ2自组装形成二维NIR-II AIE纳米粒子，在手术导航和光热消融治疗中表现出优异性能，为生物成像和纳米治疗提供了新工具。
entries.b: Near-infrared (NIR) fluorescence probes featuring ultralarge Stokes shifts and efficient aggregate-state luminescence are highly desirable for bioimaging yet remain scarce due to formidable synthetic challenges and intricate photophysical modulation. We report a facile one-step click reaction to synthesize a tetracyanoquinodimethane-derived NIR probe (TNQ2) that overcomes the long-standing nonfluorescence limitation while achieving an unprecedented 445-nanometer Stokes shift. TNQ2 self-assembles into the smallest-sized two-dimensional J-aggregates (sub-160 nanometers) with a red-shift absorption from 545 to 725 nanometers and aggregation-enhanced emission around 1000 nanometers. The radiative/nonradiative modulation balances the fluorescence/photothermal/photodynamic effect to support high-sensitivity NIR-II fluorescence imaging-guided precise glioma resection and postoperative phototherapy to substantially extend survival in orthotopic glioma models. Our molecule/nanoengineering strategy establishes a transformative paradigm for developing advanced NIR phototheranostics for brain diseases.
